== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page from the old Players Committee forum (Internet Archive captures). Sources used: topics 6033 (posts 97195, 97395), 7449 (post 100086), 9009 (post 123768).
=== Missing data ===
* Exact date: the result was posted on 22 August 2005, and the event was at Gen Con 2005 (the [[2005 World Championship]] was played there on 20 August 2005), but no post gives the day.
* The runner-up is known only by the forum handle Booker; no post read ties it to a full name, so it is not linked (it may be [[James Booker]], but that is not stated).
=== Left out ===
* A September 2005 forum remark that the event "consisted of two dudes playing sealed" (Ghent, who wrote he had never played): hearsay; the page uses Eier's own description instead.
* The [[Young Jedi]] page and [[Brad Eier]]'s results table are owned by other groups in this batch; rows were passed to them.
